# Code Ocean capsule import

Official capsule DOI: `10.24433/CO.0939560.v1`.

The paper states that this capsule contains the computer code used to generate the main results.

## Import procedure

1. Open the DOI in a normal browser.
2. Record capsule title, author, version, license, slug/ID and publication metadata.
3. Use Code Ocean's **Export** function. Include data only when the capsule license/asset terms permit redistribution.
4. Preserve the exported directory structure (`code/`, `data/`, `environment/`, `metadata/`, `REPRODUCING.md`, etc.).
5. Compute SHA-256 of the export archive and individual files.
6. Add an inventory to this directory.
7. Commit author code/data only if the license allows public GitHub redistribution. Otherwise keep the export local and commit only the inventory, hashes and an automated retrieval procedure.
8. Run the unmodified official capsule before editing any file.

Do not reconstruct missing author code from the paper and label it as original code.
